newsitem.title: USA: Blue Ridge chooses Cinergy power supply.
newsitem.headline: Blue Ridge chooses Cinergy power supply.

text.p: Blue Ridge Power Agency said Thursday it has selected Cinergy Corp as the recommended supplier of wholesale electric power to five of its members for seven years starting July 1, 1998.
Blue Ridge is a "joint action agency" which assists in making wholesale power supply arrangements for municipal electric systems in western Virginia.
Blue Ridge estimates that over the seven years of the contract the municipalities involved will save $91 million.
The five municipalites involved will continue to pay American Electric Power-Virginia to transport power to them from Cinergy.
